request.question: In flow-conformance evaluation, what does an UNKNOWN deterministic row mean, and how does it affect score denominators?

ground_truth.search_query: what does UNKNOWN mean in deterministic evaluation score denominators
addresses: el:git:github.com/AI-Substrate/harness-engineering/docs/how/flow-conformance-eval.md::Flow-conformance evaluation::Reading the numbers — the statistics behind a report::Three-valued rows and where `unknown` goes
ground_truth.resolution: Address returned ok=true via flowspace3 get at span [287,298].
source_facts: UNKNOWN means the required evidence channel was unavailable, not that the subject failed.
UNKNOWN rows are excluded from every score denominator.
3p/0f/7u means three of ten claims were measurable and all three passed, not a 30% score.
